lines.text: Many learners say: I am sorry for late.
Better: I am sorry for being late.
Say being late, not just late.
The second! Sorry for being late.

data.right: I am sorry for being late.
data.why: Say being late, not just late.

native.tip: نقول «آسف على التأخير»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول sorry for being late: “I am sorry for being late.” وليس “I am sorry for late.”

en.tip: In Arabic we say «آسف على التأخير», but in English we say sorry for being late: “I am sorry for being late.” not “I am sorry for late.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I am sorry for late.” 😅 In Arabic we say «آسف على التأخير», but in English we say sorry for being late, so the right sentence is “I am sorry for being late.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
